scope: Separate public tabular historical-source route; no source adoption, sample change, real baseline run or reopening of consumed Clerk/PDF/G03 scopes.

source.publication_time_limitation: Historical facts available before2026, but current retrieval is retrospective and is not an independently timed prediction.

input_contract.no_other_sheets: No President/House/2026 outcomes; do not traverse source dimensions with unbounded iter_rows.

raw_record_contract.class_date_term: UNKNOWN until source-bound mapping approved; do not infer from candidate FEC ID, state/year alone, election winner, or a candidate surname.
raw_record_contract.subtotal_recognition: J literals Party Votes:, Total State Votes:, Total Full Term State Votes:, Total Unexpired Term State Votes: are separate controls, never added to candidate rows. Permit stripped whitespace-only I/K for the source-bound NC total row386. Unknown nonempty J is refused.
raw_record_contract.separators: Only A ordinal and optional source-observed n/a E may remain on a separator; no forward fill across blank state/contest boundaries.

numeric_and_missing_rules: Vote counts accept exact nonnegative integer cells only; reject bool, nonfinite, negative or fractional values. An integer-valued XML number must have deterministic reviewed conversion; never derive votes from percentages.
None/blank/whitespace, n/a, dash, asterisk and # are not zero. Primary convention markers do not invalidate separately observed numeric general votes.
Preserve actual zero and one votes; do not assume one is an uncontested sentinel. Positive counts require source stage and candidate identity.
MT P304=# is a typed removed-from-ballot marker only with exact X304 footnote binding; retain rows304:307 and exclusion evidence. Do not invent a numeric zero.
Absent general counts on a primary candidate imply no general vote observation, not zero votes or a nominee.
No imputation, interpolation, rounding to integer, percentage inversion or automatic cleaning of unknown numeric strings.

event_rules.stage_columns: L/N/P/R are distinct stages; do not add them into one race feature. P alone supplies a reviewed regular-general historical feature.
event_rules.regular: D=S normally needs class/term/event proof; D=S-FULL TERM is a distinct source label, not an unconditional classII claim.
event_rules.special: D=S-UNEXPIRED TERM is retained separately and excluded from current regular S0; AZ S is also not proved regular by its generic label. No special event joins by state/year.

GA.rule: Keep November full-term P and January R as separate observations; never use W winner indicator to choose the November nominees or replace P with R. Special/unexpired rows are separate. Any use of November regularGEN as a conditional margin despite a later runoff requires explicit independent protocol interpretation/amendment; otherwise this frame slot remains blocked.

event_rules.LA: Retain every named candidate and party separately in P; multiple D/R participants refuse the current exactly-one-D-and-one-R feature. Never sum rival same-party candidates into one nominee or choose the winner.
event_rules.ME: Do not infer ranked-choice final-round provenance from GENERAL VOTES alone; require source-specific stage/round review before adoption.
event_rules.general_date: 2020-11-03 is proposed regularGEN date; require an official source-bound election-date reference before adoption. Workbook general column title alone is not a date witness.

party_identity_rules.simple: D maps to Democratic and R maps to Republican only after source identity and primary/general stage resolved. DFL is a proposed Democratic-family mapping backed by party-label sheet row29 and explicit review.
party_identity_rules.AK: N(D)/D at K17 and X17 describes nonpartisan Democratic-primary context. Preserve the literal; do not assert registered Democratic identity. Party-summary Democratic-column agreement is not sufficient to turn a nonpartisan candidate into a verified Democrat. Explicit coalition estimand amendment or an exclusion is required.
party_identity_rules.OR: DEM/IP/WF at K403 is one reported candidate/combined party label and one P count. Never split that count over tokens or add it repeatedly. Proposed Democratic-aligned mapping requires source label/nomination review; no silent substring match.
party_identity_rules.write_ins: W and source-scattered rows remain other/unallocated votes; named write-ins are not assigned D/R by biography or name.
party_identity_rules.candidate_identity: Use source row+state+event+full name and source-bound FEC ID when present; n/a/trimmed/malformed ID never creates a cross-event join. Preserve raw identifier whitespace before reviewed normalized matching.
party_identity_rules.combined_totals: No T data counts were observed in this pinned sheet; any nonblank T beyond header is a schema drift unless a separately reviewed complete-representation rule exists. Future fusion components/combined totals cannot both be summed.
party_identity_rules.unknown_party: UNKNOWN_BLOCKED rather than Democratic/Republican/Other default; a control subtotal may have blank party under its own role.

cohort.class_source_gate: Verify independent acceptance and exact source/hash/classII termJanuary3,2021-January3,2027; the existing code tuple alone is not independent seat evidence.
cohort.regular_2020_to_2026: Join same state +constitutional seat classII+regular term chain+statewide constituency with six-year gap only. Features remain separate from2026 outcomes.
cohort.AZ: Retain as2020context/special candidate, excluded from classII regular frame; no replacement frame slot.
cohort.GA: Separate full/unexpired term, no duplicate state join.
cohort.AR: No observed D general candidate; preserve frame slot with exactly-one-D/R eligibility failure instead of imputing or replacing it.
cohort.missing_prior: Selected target with missing/ineligible prior remains explicitly blocked. No selection by observed margins or eventual2026 errors; report secondary subset only with independent prespecification and full excluded-slot accounting.

cross_checks.candidate_to_contest_total: For each exact state/term/stage, sum nonoverlapping eligible candidate+other/write-in counts once and compare with its J-labeled P or R total. Primary totals cannot serve as general controls. Removed/unknown counts retain explicit dispositions.
cross_checks.party_summary: Independently parse E/F/G general summary columns for D/R/Other at the matching state row; compare only populated numeric controls after separately frozen party and event composition. B/C/D are primary controls, not general.
cross_checks.GA_summary: A single summary state row covers both full and unexpired terms (notes A68/A70) and observed totals may include general and runoff event counts. Reconcile only under an explicit reviewed four-event composition; never use a combined summary value as one regular-general prior. Do not infer composition merely because an arithmetic sum matches.
cross_checks.blank_summary: WV G58 and WY G60 and other blank fields remain unavailable controls; never zero-fill or claim a successful three-party reconciliation. Candidate-stage state totals remain a distinct check.
cross_checks.national: Summary row61 may be checked only with its exact source-defined coverage/composition. A passed national sum cannot hide a failed state/event/candidate check.
cross_checks.percentages: Q/S are diagnostic ratios with source precision tolerance; never numeric votes or substitutes for missing exact counts.
cross_checks.independence_limitation: Separate worksheets are internal consistency controls from the same FEC publication, not an independently acquired external source.

outputs: immutable raw cell occurrence ledger in ignored local storage
typed normalized records with exact source-cell witnesses
candidate feature payload only after independent numeric review
output_contract.margin: 100*(D-R)/(D+R), exactly one verified D and R, denominator>0; others recorded excluded. No winner probability.

implementation_bounds_proposed.reader: Pinned reviewed openpyxl read_only=True,data_only=False,keep_links=False; no macro/formula evaluation or external links; source/hash verified before reader. Reader is separate from old PDF installer/G03 path.
implementation_bounds_proposed.source_binding: One exact workbook size/hash plus pinned protocol/contract/reader code and package versions. Existing raw source never modified; no publisher workbook committed.

acceptance_criteria.criteria: Review exact source headers/ranges, dates/class/term mapping, general/runoff/special and party semantics; resolve AK/OR/ME/GA ambiguity or retain blocked slots. This proposal is not self-certification.

Implement separate pure row parser and bounded workbook adapter. Test row roles, # removed candidate, blank vszero vsone, bool/nonfinite/fraction, duplicate rows/FEC IDs, primary contamination, GA terms/year/runoff, LA multiple nominees, AK/OR parties, partial summary controls, altered header/hash, formula/external link refusal, fixed range, read/output/deadline failure and no partial adoption.
Nonimplementer runs fixtures and additional counterexamples on both supported runtimes. No source adoption merely from unit PASS.

Versioned separate recorded run with exact source/code/input hashes, reader version, start/end, limits, errors and33-slot coverage. Zero network/model/2026 outcome access; retain failed attempt and all discrepancies.

Check cell witnesses, candidate identity, totals and summary definition, class/date/candidate lineage, uncertainty/exclusions. Only explicitly accepted rows may become historical inputs; unresolved slots stay blocked.

Separately freeze target race sample, final ballots/geography and predeclared adjustments, then feature isolation and sealed outcomes. Retain original broad24House/up-to8Senate and deep4House/2Senate completion requirements; Senate source progress does not complete House/advanced variants.

simpler_route_assessment.can_replace_dependency: The scientific baseline needs validated official historical counts; it does not inherently need a particular PDF parser or installer. A separately reviewed FEC tabular adapter can supply accepted counts without passing consumed Clerk PDF/G03 implementation-specific gates.
simpler_route_assessment.cannot_bypass: Do not mark old PDF/G03 gates passed, reuse consumed release scopes, reinterpret fixtures as real counts, or waive candidate/class/event/geography/selection/leakage requirements. Full original contract remains incomplete.
simpler_route_assessment.remaining_original_contract: Target2026 final ballots/geography, original full race selection, eligible historical counts for every selected target, House prior data, sealed retrospective outcomes, uncertainty, matched advanced comparators, reproducibility and independent review remain separate.
